title: ExtraBiblicalSource
description: A non-canonical source the project may later connect to passages: ANE text, Second Temple literature, Greco-Roman background, patristic source, historian, inscription, archaeological find, papyrus, or apologetic/scientific source. HARD FENCE: every record MUST declare layer=context and a non-canonical trust_zone. Links to scripture are ONLY via RelationshipObject (asserted/inferred + tradition_scope + evidence) — never as properties of a ScripturePassage. This is what keeps the canonical biblical layer uncontaminated (taxonomy-scaffold v0.2 Patch 6).

layer.description: MUST be 'context' — never 'canonical'. Enforces the fence.

trust_zone.description: Never 'canonical' or 'asserted-textual'. Extra-biblical material is background, not scripture.

citation.description: Standard scholarly citation / catalog id (e.g. COS, OGIS, Rahlfs, IAA).
